description: Read ONE attachment of an email. A text attachment (plain text, CSV, JSON, XML, Markdown, calendar and similar) comes back as text; an HTML attachment comes back reduced to text; a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image up to 1 MB comes back as an image; any other file comes back as base64 when it is 256 KB or smaller, and otherwise as its description with a statement that it is too large to return. PDF and office documents are not converted to text. Identify the attachment by part_index or filename from the attachments list getEmail returns; an email with a single attachment needs neither. Long text is returned max_chars at a time: when truncated is true, call again with offset set to next_offset. Result: the attachment is in data.

api_key.description: Your API key from createEmailAddress, used in place of sign-in.

filename.description: The attachment's filename, when part_index is not to hand. Matched exactly, then ignoring case.

id.description: ID of the email the attachment belongs to.

max_chars.description: For text: the most characters to return in this call.

offset.description: For text: the character to start from. Use next_offset from the previous call to continue.

part_index.description: The attachment's part_index from the email's attachments list. Preferred over filename, which need not be unique.

source.description: Whether id is an email you received or one you sent.

name: getEmailAttachment

outputSchema.description: Envelope; the attachment is in data.

total_chars.description: Text length; only the part read if the file was cut.

title: Read email attachment
